name: t3-website
description: Showcase website for NSU CSE499B Section 13 Group 5: offline disaster damage mapping from satellite image pairs

scripts.prebuild: npm run validate && npm run facts && npm run guidelines && npm run palette && npm run selfcheck
scripts.build:fixtures: node scripts/validate-data.ts fixtures/data --fixtures && vite build --mode fixtures --outDir dist-fixtures
scripts.check:model-file: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import { FIELD_MODEL as m } from './src/core/modelConfig.ts'; if (!fs.existsSync('public' + m.file) || fs.statSync('public' + m.file).size !== m.bytes) { console.error('The field model is not at public' + m.file + ' (or has the wrong size). Copy it there before a deploy: see README.md.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.deploy:check: node scripts/check-facts.ts --strict && npm run check:model-file && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
